text:
Aisha (People Ops): Flagging offer for Miguel Santos. Candidate asking $235k total cash for IC4 SF. Band top is $225k. He also requests an earlier start 2025-11-05 due to visa interview slot. Need comp exception, benefits check, and routing.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Miguel is high-priority. Team will lose momentum without him. Market intel from recent hires supports requested comp. We can cover $5k from team budget; asking comp-committee for an additional $5k uplift.
Renee (Comp): Please attach market docs (benchmarks, interviews). For IC4 SF our standard max is $225k; exceptions up to $10k considered with director approval and comp chair sign-off.
Diego (Finance): Current headcount and budget are fine but any uplift that increases OTE >10% needs FP&A approval. Please quantify total comp and any signing/relocation numbers.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Total comp request: base 210k + target bonus 15k + signing 10k = 235k OTE. Relocation: standard lump sum $7k. I can shift some hiring budget to cover signing if approved.
Hannah (Benefits): Quick note: benefits eligibility cutoff is first of month. Start date 11/05 would miss 11/01 cutoff and delay benefits until 12/01. We occasionally provide a one-time taxable premium bridge for up to 30 days; requires HR Director approval.
Aisha (People Ops): Could we instead switch start to 11/01 remote and in-office on 11/05? Would that preserve benefits? Candidate needs to be physically present for onboarding but visa constraints might prevent 11/01.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Candidate cannot legally start before visa clearance. So 11/05 is the earliest he can be in office. Need benefits bridge.
Renee (Comp): I'll open expedited comp-committee request. Required approvers: Comp Chair (Nina), Dir Eng (Alyssa), FP&A (Diego). Include rationale and hire impact. ETA 48hrs for expedited review.
LegalBot: Reminder: include visa-contingent language in offer and outline allowed employment start window. If relocation included, specify tax treatment and whether gross-up applies.
Diego (Finance): We can approve $5k uplift if comp-committee signs off. Bridge benefits cost estimate: about $420 for health premiums for 30 days. Finance ok to cover one-time cost pending director sign-off on taxable accommodation.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Acknowledge business impact and confirm we accept provisional uplift policy: provisional +$5k for 90 days while final approval completes. I will provide the market docs link by EOD.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks. I'll include benefits-bridge request and mark as taxable accommodation requiring HR Director sign-off. Routing notes: expedited packet will include market links, hiring manager ack, finance approval in-thread.
Renee (Comp): Comp-committee approved provisional +$5k (90 days). Forwarding to OfferOps to draft offer with visa-contingent start, relocation $7k, signing $10k, and benefits-bridge $420 as taxable one-time. Director-level approvals pending final sign-off.
Aisha (People Ops): Great. @Tom please confirm when you drop the benchmarks. @Diego I'll ping you for director sign-off after comp chair routes final approval. OfferOps will send draft once they receive packet. :thumbsup:
LegalBot: OfferOps notified to include contingency language and relocation tax note.
Tom (Hiring Manager): Uploaded benchmarks. Confirming team will absorb $5k from hiring budget. Thanks everyone.
Aisha (People Ops): Closing notes: once OfferOps sends draft, please review within 2 business hours so we can meet candidate timeline.
